from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output/gen_record')
CAMS = ['front', 'side', 'top', 'oblique']


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    r = Robot()
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video='frames')
    state = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
    q = state[58:87].copy()  # currently held joint targets

    # From the overhead depth view the handle is just to the right of the

        1.25, .10, 1.65, 1.30,
        1.25, .10, 1.65, 1.30,
        .20, 1.25, .10, 1.65, 1.30,
    ]
    lift = q.copy()
    lift[1] = 1.58
    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.stack([q, lift]), dt=1.0,
                   interpolate='linear', cameras=CAMS, video='mp4',
                   note='visually align, close around handle, lower then lift')
    res.save(str(OUT))
    report = {
        'control_steps': res.meta.get('control_steps'),
        'time_left_s': res.meta.get('time_left_s'),
        'task': res.meta.get('task'),
        'reason': res.meta.get('reason'),
    }

    print(json.dumps(report))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
